name: Rio
source:
Rank: A-class Spirit

Rio is a character exclusively to the game Date A Live Twin Edition: Rio Reincarnation and the novel version of the game. Rio has a very childlike, yet also kind personality. She restarted Eden in order to try to help Shido, who she views as her father, find happiness.
